purpose: Later CPU-versus-ROCm correctness and throughput gate. R1E retains this registered procedure but does not execute or accept it.

deterministic_policy_fixture.input: The four-float observations from the registered 10,000-decision transport trace.
deterministic_policy_fixture.architecture: Fixed-weight float32 MLP: 4 inputs, 32 ReLU hidden units, separate 3-logit movement and 2-logit submit heads.
deterministic_policy_fixture.weights: Generated once from a registered signed 31-bit seed and hashed; the same state dictionary is used by both backends.
deterministic_policy_fixture.action_rule: Argmax per branch after applying the environment's mechanical masks. Registered biases must keep the online trace on stay/continue so the R1C truncation path remains comparable.
deterministic_policy_fixture.checkpoint: Save once, reload independently on CPU and candidate, and require identical parameter names, shapes, dtypes, and SHA-256.
deterministic_policy_fixture.export: Export once to ONNX, hash the file, compare CPU ONNX Runtime outputs against PyTorch CPU outputs, and require ROCm PyTorch to match the same registered logits and actions.

correctness_gates.checkpoint_reload: exact parameters and actions; logits within tolerance

throughput_gate.timing_scope: End-to-end synchronous policy inference, action selection, in-memory trace capture, and Unity/Python LLAPI step loop; process startup, warmup, file serialization, and trace comparison excluded.
throughput_gate.ordering: Alternate CPU and candidate runs on the same machine and record background-load notes.
throughput_gate.comparison_statistic: median decisions per second across the two measured runs
throughput_gate.improvement_rule: Candidate median decisions per second must be strictly greater than CPU median after every correctness gate passes.

decision.accept: All correctness gates pass and the throughput improvement rule passes.
decision.reject: Any correctness gate fails or candidate throughput does not improve.
decision.fallback: Retain the verified CPU backend and preserve all negative/null evidence.

non_goals: BDQ training, replay, or learned weights
